pattern.rule: In a claim-evaluation item (Yes/No + reason, or 'weakens X, because'), the key is the only option whose reason tests exactly the claim as the stem states it (same variable, step or range and subject, with a value that contradicts it).
pattern.why: Both graders named the same rule on the same three items (3 of 3 vs 25% chance). Every item it decides is already dropped by R6 (both graders, 2+ distractors), so R8 removes nothing further and no blind re-application could change the outcome. Recorded for the brief: the Yes/No template survived the v11 lessons.
